findings.issue: Renders 'agent' as «代理» (twice). The binding glossary and zh-CN style guide (§Locale calls: agent → 智能体) fix the term; the zh-CN catalogues use 智能体 761 times and use 代理 only for a network PROXY — including in this same browser domain (ui.browser.extensions.permission_proxy «读取和更改你的代理设置»). In a browser notice «由代理控制的标签页» therefore reads as 'a tab controlled by a proxy', and the same strip's message line says «智能体驱动的标签页», so the explanation appears to describe a different actor. Meaning error in a security-relevant notice.
findings.suggested: 密码管理器扩展无法在由智能体控制的标签页中打开。请在你自己的标签页中继续登录；它与此浏览器共享登录会话，因此智能体之后可以在已登录状态下继续。
findings.disposition: changes requested — translator to replace 代理 with 智能体; re-audit required.
